action_summary: Two layers, one mechanism. (1) A bound row that advertises a sha256 pin is held to it: the kernel treats a pin as a RELATION (a 64-hex value naming a file must equal that file's sha256), not a vocabulary, so a row may invent any key name and is still checked. (2) The verdict that audit derives is made CONSEQUENTIAL: availability_v1 -- the module live_integrated_brain_v1 builds its bound set from -- now charges a STALE row 'verification_evidence_is_stale', so three capabilities stop being offered. Measured at a70480d4: 141 bound rows; 160 distinct verification keys, 86 private to one row; verification.status positive on 141/141 and NEVER negative in any of the 142 commits that touched the registry; 0 of 141 pins compared to their own adapter by anything in the tree.

agent_orientation.earlier_routes_exhausted_reason: Four candidate mechanisms were built or measured before this one and each was rejected on measurement, not preference. (1) Import-graph reachability: 76% of files are imported by nobody, because this repository dispatches by CLI subprocess and registry path. (2) An alias-aware import resolver, corrected to agree with all three known-live modules, still found only 4% of census 'orphans' reachable from real entrypoints. (3) Transitive name reachability exploded to 95% because SCHEMA is defined in 1708 modules. (4) A name-matching orphan gate agreed with the repository's own census on 1 of 40 known-dead modules. Measuring the same question revealed that the orphan population is FLAT (562 -> 554 dead over 12 merges, 24% -> 24%), so the orphan gate's premise was contradicted by the data and it was deleted rather than shipped. The surviving blocker is one layer down, in the 141-row capability door.

causal_blocker: The repository could already record proof-of-execution (capability_receipt_lane_v1: execute, pin blob sha, verify as a second identity; all 15 receipt pins measured FRESH) and currency (rule_expiry_v1: FRESH/STALE/UNKNOWN). Missing was the join: nothing read a pin back, so a bound row's status was an assertion no later edit could contradict. 142 commits touched the registry and zero ever carried a negative verdict. A status field that only ever takes one value is not a status.
expected_parent_change: Of 141 bound rows, 3 names a checkable pin that their adapter contradicts, and the gate refuses when that count rises or when a new unfalsifiable bound row arrives.
expected_parent_frontier_change: The capability door was reachable for 141 of 2308 governed modules (6.1%). Those 141 rows were previously un-auditable; they now carry a falsifiable property.
explicit_user_authorization: Owner instruction 2026-11-03, verbatim: 'You sure this is the smartest approach? You must think from the deepest layer, from first principles of everything.' and 'And don't forget we want a very smart, most advanced, sentient-like creature. We don't want a static code.' The second sentence is the acceptance criterion: a per-incident static guard is rejected in kind, and the deliverable must be a generalizing mechanism.
falsification_condition: Any of: (a) adding a bound row whose runtime_sha256 does not match its adapter does NOT produce ORIENTATION_A_BOUND_ROW_CLAIMS_A_PIN_THE_FILE_NO_LONGER_MATCHES; (b) removing the kernel call from orientation_errors does NOT fail test_the_orientation_check_surfaces_a_false_pin; (c) a row using a key name the kernel has never seen, holding a matching sha, is NOT compared -- that would prove the kernel is vocabulary-bound; (d) the 3 rows stale at a70480d4 block a PR that did not touch them. (e) a STALE row does NOT lose its place in availability_v1.runnable(); (f) an UNVERIFIED row IS withdrawn; (g) an audit exception removes capabilities instead of failing open; (h) a row is silently dropped from the verdict map (141 rows share only 132 adapter module names, so keying by module collapses nine).

load_bearing_primary.interpretation: This change makes no capability claim and moves no obligation. Its value is that the 141-row capability door becomes auditable, which is a precondition for counting any of those obligations honestly rather than by self-issued assertion.
load_bearing_primary.wall_clock_cost_ub: under five minutes of CI; the audit parses one JSON registry

parent_frontier_change: A bound capability's status stops being an unfalsifiable assertion and becomes a claim that a later edit can contradict.
prior_work_reused: capability_receipt_lane_v1.py already implements execute -> sha-pinned blob -> independent verification and was read first; its 15 pins were measured FRESH and are the reason this work targets the REGISTRY rather than re-inventing receipts. rule_expiry_v1.py already implements FRESH/STALE/UNKNOWN and was checked for reuse. capability_receipt_lane_v1.sha256_file is the same one-line hash; the kernel keeps its own to stay import-free on the guard path. agent_orientation_check_v1.orientation_errors is the existing enforced hook every PR already passes; nothing new was wired into the merge path.

measurement_commands: python3 -c "import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'.');from canonical.runtime import binding_pin_is_current_v1 as K;print(K.audit('.')['stale'], len(K.audit('.')['unfalsifiable']))"

obs_blocker.surviving_causal_blocker: Verification evidence is written and never read back, so a capability's advertised status is unfalsifiable: the code that was verified and the code that would run are permitted to diverge silently.

obs_capability.existing_inherited_routes_checked: capability_receipt_lane_v1 (reused its execute/receipt/hash pattern and measured its 15 pins FRESH); rule_expiry_v1 (checked for reuse, already implements FRESH/STALE/UNKNOWN); census_orphan_capabilities_v1 (the repository's own orphan census, used as ground truth against which four candidate mechanisms were tested); agent_orientation_check_v1.orientation_errors (the existing enforced hook); BOUND_CAPABILITY_REGISTRY_V1.dataset

recursive_obs.observed_state_change: 3 of 141 bound rows are STALE and now cost their capability its offer; 138 are UNVERIFIED and are explicitly NOT withdrawn; any rise in either count refuses on the next consequential action.

stop_condition: Stops when the new suite passes, each of the four falsification conditions above is exercised by a test that fails when the mechanism is broken, repo_integrity_guard_v1 stays at violations=0, and the existing 42 orientation/admission tests still pass.
weakens_existing_guard: No guard is weakened. availability_v1 can only ADD an unmet requirement, and it fails OPEN on any audit exception, so a broken kernel cannot delete the option set. UNVERIFIED is deliberately not a blocker. The three withdrawals are refuted evidence, not suspicion.
